description: Golden set evaluation framework: define 10 representative LT themes as fixtures, implement quality evaluation checks (URL reachability, structure scoring, note completeness, character limits), and CI integration script
steps: In packages/evaluation/src/golden-set/, create fixture files for 10 representative LT themes as specified in design section 21.1. Each fixture has: {id, theme, audience, duration, urls[], expectedStructure (problem/solution/evidence/summary), prohibitedExpressions[], expectedSlideCountRange}. Themes should cover: technical explanation, new feature intro, case study, comparison, tutorial, architecture overview, best practices, migration guide, tool introduction, performance optimization.

In packages/evaluation/src/checks/url-reachability.ts, implement check that extracts all URLs from generated markdown and verifies they resolve (HEAD request). Returns {totalUrls, reachableCount, unreachableUrls[]}. Note: this check requires network access and should be marked as integration-only.

In packages/evaluation/src/checks/structure-scoring.ts, implement check that evaluates slide deck structure: presence of problem statement, proposed solution, supporting evidence, summary/conclusion. Use simple heuristic matching (keyword detection in slide titles and content) rather than LLM for CI speed. Returns score 1-5.

In packages/evaluation/src/checks/note-completeness.ts, implement check that verifies: every slide has presenterNote (non-empty), every slide has keyPoints array with at least 1 item, no presenterNote exceeds 3000 chars. Returns {totalSlides, slidesWithNotes, slidesWithKeyPoints, oversizedNotes[]}.
In packages/evaluation/src/checks/character-limits.ts, implement check that verifies per-slide text constraints: title line count, body text density, code block size. Returns violations array.

In packages/evaluation/src/checks/prohibited-expressions.ts, implement check for forbidden patterns: exaggerated claims, unqualified absolutes, marketing language without evidence. Configurable pattern list per fixture.

In packages/evaluation/src/runner.ts, implement evaluation runner: takes generated markdown + fixture definition, runs all applicable checks, produces evaluation report with pass/fail per check and overall verdict based on thresholds from design section 21.2.

In packages/evaluation/src/cli.ts, create CLI entry point that can be called from CI: reads golden set fixtures, for each fixture generates expected evaluation inputs (mock or previously generated deck.md samples as baselines), runs evaluation checks, exits with non-zero if any threshold is breached.
Add evaluation script to root package.json: 'eval' script that runs the golden set evaluation. Add to CI pipeline definition.
Write unit tests for each check module with known-good and known-bad markdown inputs
acceptance_criteria: 10 golden set fixtures are defined covering diverse LT themes
URL reachability check correctly identifies unreachable URLs
Structure scoring check gives 4+ to well-structured decks and <4 to poorly structured ones
Note completeness check detects missing notes and oversized notes
Character limit check detects text overflow violations
Prohibited expression check catches exaggerated language
Evaluation runner produces structured report with pass/fail per check
CLI exits with non-zero when thresholds are breached
All evaluation unit tests pass with pnpm test
verification: Run pnpm test to confirm evaluation framework tests pass
Run pnpm build to confirm compilation
Run pnpm eval (or equivalent) with sample fixture to confirm runner executes checks
